_meta.description: Cap-group definitions for V3_UNIQUE_TARGET_CAPS. When two or more c-prefixes share a 'cap group', the placement engine's count-toward-cap logic treats them as a single account: a placement of any member increments the group's count, the cap applies to the group sum, and reaching the cap blocks all members from subsequent slots.
_meta.motivation: ER/SoTE re-use c-prefixes (c3251 Tree Sentinel / c6251 Tree Sentinel SoTE, c4191 Scarab / c6201 Scarab, etc.) represent the same chr identity from a player-recognition standpoint. Without a shared cap, both prefixes can place independently (e.g. 2 + 2 = 4 Tree Sentinels in a run), breaking the rarity contract per-prefix caps were chosen for.

schema.groups: dict from group name (string, snake_case) to a list of c-prefixes that share the cap. Group cap value is read from V3_UNIQUE_TARGET_CAPS — every member must have the same cap value in V3_UNIQUE_TARGET_CAPS, or a HIGH-severity audit finding fires.
schema.name_format: snake_case; lowercase; descriptive ('tree_sentinel_iconic', 'scarab_unified'); avoid version numbers.
schema.membership: Every cp in a group must (a) exist in nr_enemy_tags.json and (b) have an identical 'cap' value in V3_UNIQUE_TARGET_CAPS.
schema.uniqueness: Each cp may appear in AT MOST one group. The audit script enforces this.
schema.carrying_cap: The cap value lives on each member's V3_UNIQUE_TARGET_CAPS entry, NOT here. This file is purely the grouping. Rationale: keep cap-value tuning in one place (the existing dict) — this file only changes what counts the cap is *across*.

engine_behavior.accounting_key: When evaluating cap-block / increment / reserve-against, the engine resolves each cp through _resolve_cap_group_key(cp) which returns the group name if cp is in a group, else cp itself. All cap reads and writes use the resolved key.
engine_behavior.reservation_pass: The reservation pre-pass iterates V3_RESERVATION_FLOORS unchanged. When the pre-pass tries to reserve N slots for cp X (which is in group G), it consults _placed_counts[G] (not [X]) and reserves up to (cap_G - placed_G - already_preserved_G) slots, where already_preserved_G is the sum of preserves for every cp in G.
engine_behavior.msb_freeze: begin_msb's frozen blocked set computes group counts; if a group is at/over cap, EVERY cp in the group is added to msb_blocked_cps.
engine_behavior.telemetry: Reservation log and audit_placement_budget_consistency report cap state by GROUP for grouped cps, by CP for ungrouped. Spoiler-format compatible: grouped placements still show their cp name, but cap-state summary lines list 'group=<name>: N/cap members={cp1, cp2, ...}'.

tree_sentinel_iconic.rationale: Both are mounted Tree Sentinel — same chr identity. c3251 is the ER duo / Altus overworld variant; c6251 is the SoTE-area variant.
